title: Lider Almoxarifado
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de Líder Almoxarifado para atuar no nosso time de Suprimentos.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Supervisionar emissão, entrada e saída de notas fiscais;
  • Supervisionar entrada e saída de combustível no posto de abastecimento e atender as exigências legais dos órgãos fiscalizadores;
  • Supervisionar o processo de estocagem dos materiais, de forma a preservar a sua integridade física e condições de uso, de acordo com as características de cada material, bem como facilitar a sua localização e manuseio;
  • Supervisionar controles dos estoques, através de registros apropriados (SAP), visando facilitar a reposição e elaboração dos inventários;
  • Elaboração de inventário;
  • Gerar relatórios de acompanhamento.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Cursando Técnico ou Graduação Engenharia/Administração;
  • Experiência (Estoque e/ou Controle);
  • Conhecimento pacote office;
  • CNH AB;

Localidades:

Residir em São José do Rio Preto, Tanabi ou Monte Aprazível.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Consultor(a) de Implantação e Sucesso do Cliente Sênior - Latam
description:
Se sente que já domina o técnico, mas quer usar isso em algo maior do que fechar mais um balanço, essa vaga é sobre isso.

Você vai liderar a implantação dos clientes mais complexos da nossa carteira: empresas de capital aberto e fechado que publicam demonstrações financeiras e precisam de consolidação de verdade. Não é suporte, não é operação. É você junto com o cliente desenhando como a informação financeira dele vai funcionar dentro da plataforma.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ser o principal responsável técnico pela implantação dos clientes de alta complexidade do nosso canal estratégico.
  • Elaborar e revisar o layout do cliente na plataforma com total autonomia. É aqui que você traduz o plano de contas, a estrutura societária e as regras de consolidação da empresa em algo que funciona de verdade
  • Montar o cronograma de implantação e defender os prazos junto ao cliente, com revisão do Coordenador
  • Acompanhar o cliente até a conferência dos saldos consolidados e convertidos. Você não entrega e some, você fica até o número fechar
  • Elaborar DFC, DMPL e DVA em cases complexos, de empresas com demonstrações financeiras publicadas, capital aberto e fechado
  • Aplicar CPC, IFRS e consolidação em estruturas societárias que a maioria dos profissionais nunca viu de perto, incluindo conversão de moeda e múltiplas entidades
  • Participar das reuniões de decisão do projeto junto ao cliente, alinhado com o Coordenador. Você fala direto com controller, CFO e diretoria, e a sua leitura técnica faz diferença na conversa
  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes complexos, priorizando, negociando escopo e sustentando a relação ao longo do projeto
  • Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes complexos de ponta a ponta, com autonomia para priorizar, negociar escopo e sustentar a relação depois que o projeto vira. O cliente continua sendo seu
  • Monitorar o risco de cada conta com método, olhando adoção da plataforma, frequência de uso, troca de interlocutor e sinais de insatisfação. Risco identificado cedo é problema resolvido, risco identificado tarde é cliente perdido
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas com o cliente, mostrando o que a plataforma já entregou de resultado e o que ainda dá para destravar. É a conversa que renova a relação todo ciclo
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão dentro da conta, novas empresas do grupo, novos módulos, novos times que podem usar. Você enxerga antes porque conhece a estrutura por dentro;

O que precisamos que você tenha

  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas
  • Domínio de CPC, IFRS e normas do CFC
  • Conhecimento avançado em consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras
  • Experiência real conduzindo projetos, não só participando deles
  • Excel e Word em nível avançado
  • Espanhol fluente. Requisito obrigatório , você vai conduzir reuniões e projetos nesse idioma;

Por que essa vaga é diferente

  • Tecnologia de verdade: você trabalha dentro de uma plataforma, não de uma planilha. O conhecimento técnico que você levou anos construindo vira produto, processo e escala
  • Temas estratégicos do mercado financeiro: consolidação multiempresa, conversão de moeda, estrutura de capital, tudo o que o setor olha de perto
  • IA aplicada a finanças: você vai estar perto do que existe de mais atual. Estamos construindo isso na prática, com quem entende de contabilidade participando das decisões, não recebendo o resultado pronto
  • Autonomia real: senioridade aqui significa decidir, não pedir aprovação para cada passo

title: Cloud FinOps Analyst
description:
Cloud FinOps Analyst (Multi-Cloud & GenAI Infrastructure) -

Location: Hybrid

Role Type: Full-Time

Only CVs in English will be considered

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, highly analytical Cloud FinOps Analyst to establish deep financial visibility, control, and efficiency across our multi-cloud and modern AI infrastructure.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Executive Leadership . You will bring rigorous financial discipline and data-driven insights to our infrastructure spend across AWS, GCP, OpenAI, and Anthropic .

We aren't just looking for someone who monitors high-level UI dashboards. We need an analyst who can roll up their sleeves, write complex SQL queries against raw billing data, run quantitative root-cause analyses on spend anomalies, and partner directly with engineering teams to execute technical cost-optimization strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Spend Visibility: Build executive dashboards and granularity reports across AWS, GCP, OpenAI, and Anthropic, tracking key metrics like amortized spend, forecast accuracy, unit costs, and token usage.
  • Structured Anomaly & Variance Root-Cause Analysis: Quantify and investigate budget variances. Methodically isolate drivers by slicing raw billing data by Cloud Provider.
  • Deep Infrastructure Optimization: Partner with DevOps and Engineering to evaluate technical efficiency—moving beyond basic off-hour schedules to rightsizing utilization metrics (vCPU/Memory), storage lifecycle tiering, Spot instances, and container cost allocation (EKS/GKE).
  • Commitment Strategy Management: Evaluate, purchase, and manage commitment-based discounts (AWS Savings Plans/Reserved Instances, GCP CUDs) to maximize discount coverage while maintaining flexibility.
  • GenAI & Token Cost Governance: Track unit economics (cost per prompt/token, custom GPU cluster utilization) and partner with AI engineers to set usage quotas, rate limits, and governance.
  • Cross-Functional Reconciliation: Bridge the gap between Finance and Engineering by reconciling accounting discrepancies (amortization, tax, out-of-cycle charges, billing cycle cutoff dates) using AWS Cost & Usage Reports (CUR) as the single source of truth.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud FinOps, Cloud Cost Engineering, or Technical Financial Analysis in multi-cloud environments.
  • Hands-On SQL Capability: Proven ability to query billing datasets using aggregations (GROUP BY), window functions (PARTITION BY, dynamic rolling averages), and deduplication logic. (Note: Hands-on SQL is evaluated in our interview process).
  • Cloud & Pricing Mechanics: In-depth technical knowledge of AWS/GCP services and pricing trade-offs between On-Demand, Savings Plans, RIs, and CUDs.
  • Quantitative Problem-Solving: Ability to structure investigation frameworks for unexpected cost spikes rather than relying on high-level theoretical assumptions.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Strong communication skills to clearly articulate engineering trade-offs to Finance, and financial realities to Engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or AWS/GCP technical certifications.
  • Hands-on experience tracking spend, token metrics, and custom GPU infrastructure for GenAI platforms ( OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI ).
  • Experience automating billing reconciliation or data pipelines using Python or advanced data modeling.

What We Value

  • Total Ownership: You don't just flag a spend increase—you quantify it, isolate the root cause, propose an engineering fix, and track the realized savings.
  • Technical Depth: You understand the difference between high-level dashboard summaries and underlying resource usage metrics.
  • Bridge Building: You foster a culture of cost accountability and education across engineering teams without hindering innovation or development velocity.

What We Look For

• Strong sense of ownership — takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

• Self-motivated and proactive; able to operate independently with minimal supervision.

• A good team player who collaborates effectively across teams, geographies, and time zones.

• Proven track record of delivering measurable results in previous roles.

title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)

Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)

Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Reports To: CRO / Founder

Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)

We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities.

  • In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations:

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize).
  • Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations.
  • Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).

2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR):

  • Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners.
  • Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices ( Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e ) where applicable.
  • Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.

3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements:

  • Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors.
  • Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports.
  • Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).

4. Data Integrity & Reporting:

  • Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity.
  • Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices.
  • Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies).
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (QuickBooks, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais , basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote working environment with flexibility.
  • Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

title: Senior AI Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Office Management Manager-Brazil(A114797)
description:
Position Overview

As a comprehensive workplace manager, you will be responsible for establishing the administrative system for large‑scale integrated workplaces, leading team management, and conducting in‑depth alignment with corporate headquarters administration.

Application Scope

This role applies to large‑scale integrated workplaces (headcount ≥ 50) or regional administrative lead positions. Incumbents are expected to undertake team management, budget decision‑making and strategic planning responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1.1 Workplace Operation Strategy & Management

1）Formulate regional workplace operation strategies, drive continuous improvement of office environment and employee experience upgrade.

2）Build regional 5S management system and develop reusable management standards.

3）Plan annual activity calendar and oversee delivery of regional cultural events.

4）Establish reception service standards and coordinate cross‑regional high‑profile receptions.

5）Take overall charge of regional EHS compliance management and develop emergency response frameworks.

1.2 Expense & Budget Oversight

1）Lead preparation and review of regional administrative budgets, and take accountability for regional budget outcomes.

2）Approve regional expense disbursements, monitor compliance risks and identify cost‑saving & efficiency‑improvement opportunities.

3）Collaborate with headquarters to deliver regional cost optimization and maintain healthy overall expense performance.

4）Oversee payments to regional vendors, control payment schedules and leverage payment terms to optimize cash flow.

1.3 Asset Management Oversight

1）Establish regional asset management policy framework to guarantee consistency between asset records and physical inventory.

2）Approve major vehicle procurement and disposal proposals, and optimize allocation of regional vehicle resources.

3）Align with headquarters asset policies, and supervise regional asset inventory and disposal activities.

1.4 Vendor Management

1）Participate in headquarters‑level vendor framework negotiations to optimize regional supply chain.

2）Manage relationships with key regional vendors and drive continuous service improvement.

3）Develop regional vendor tier‑based management system to iteratively optimize supply‑chain structure.

4）Review and approve proposals for regional vendor onboarding and offboarding.

1.5 Regional Workplace Construction & Standardization

1）Develop strategies for launching new country‑level workplaces, align with headquarters resources to ensure standardized implementation.

2）Contribute to headquarters administrative standard formulation, and supervise regional training and compliance execution.

3）Facilitate experience sharing and methodology accumulation across regional workplaces.

1.6 Visa & Expat Assignment Support

1）Build regional support framework for expatriate employees, coordinate resources to guarantee smooth on‑landing for assignees.

2）Collaborate with headquarters Administration and HR teams to continuously enhance regional expatriate support solutions.

1.7 Onboarding & Offboarding Administrative Support

1）Establish standardized SOPs for regional employee onboarding and offboarding administrative support to deliver seamless employee experience and efficient handover.

1.8 Digital‑enabled Administrative Service

1）Lead promotion and operation of regional administrative service platforms to advance digitalization of local administrative services.

2）Consolidate regional system requirements and partner with headquarters Administration to iterate platform functionalities.

1.9 Communication & IT Infrastructure Support

1）Develop regional communication and IT infrastructure operation strategies to ensure stable connectivity of office networks and communication facilities.

2）Participate in formulation and optimization of regional IT support solutions.

1.10 Team Management

3）Directly manage administrative teams including Supervisors and Specialists, covering recruitment & selection, performance management and talent development.

4）Drive cross‑department collaboration within the region, represent the administrative function in business decision‑making and major project governance.

5）Maintain close alignment with headquarters Administration, and contribute to headquarters administrative decision‑making and system building.

6）Set up regional administrative talent pipeline development mechanisms.

Education & Professional Experience

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Administration Management, Business Administration, Human Resources or related disciplines is preferred.

2. 5‑8 years or above working experience in administration, operation or relevant fields, with minimum 2 years of people‑management experience.

3. Prior experience in multinational enterprises or cross‑cultural management is a plus.

Core Competencies

1. Strategic Thinking: Systematic mindset, capable of contributing to headquarters standard‑setting and providing professional judgment for regional matters.

2. Business Acumen: Take ownership of regional administrative budget performance; proactively identify cost‑reduction and efficiency‑gain opportunities.

3. Organizational Influence: Direct‑line team management capability, with proven track record in talent selection, development and performance management.

4. Cross‑cultural Communication: Deliver effective communication across cultures and hierarchy levels, and manage complex stakeholder relationships.

5. Risk Anticipation: Foresee potential risks, formulate contingency plans and resolve regional issues in a systematic manner.

Language & Qualifications

1. Fluent in English and local language for high‑level business communication and negotiation.

2. Possess a valid local driving license.

Next steps:

As part of our application process, certain positions at our company require a pre-employment screening to ensure the reliability and integrity of our employees. This screening is a standard procedure and may include components such as a Criminal Background Check from your current or previous country of residence over the past five years. Additionally, the process may involve an integrity questionnaire, verification of identification, diplomas, work experience, and consultation of the central insolvency register.

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

  • Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.).
  • Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions.
  • Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates.
  • Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy.
  • Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

  • Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese.
  • 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation).
  • Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills.
  • Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload.
  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Sr Sales Operations Manager - SMB
description:

  • Architect end-to-end merchant journey systems. Define clear entry/exit criteria, operational SOPs, and category-specific methodologies to drive merchant performance and BD team efficiency.

  • Partner directly with Product and Growth teams to secure priority exposure, subsidy budgets, and strategic campaign placements for SMB merchants.
  • Conduct research into restaurant unit economics, menu composition, gross margins, menu design, and business workflows to distill strategic insights into practical operational checklists for BDs.
  • Formulate strategic recommendations, continuously refine SOPs, and deliver training and enablement materials that turn complex operational methodologies into high-impact sales execution.

  • 8+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Strategy, or Business Analytics within SMB SaaS, FoodTech, or Marketplace environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience querying large datasets with SQL to perform root-cause analysis, measure business impact, and drive data-informed strategies.
  • Proven track record of combining sales operations with GTM strategy—identifying key leverage points in sales processes and exploring innovative partnership/commercial models around market trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business logic into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), structured playbooks, and training programs for BD/Sales teams.

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

Buscamos um Supervisor de Segurança Empresarial para atuar no segmento de telecomunicações , garantindo a proteção de pessoas, ativos e infraestrutura crítica.

Conheça nossa história:

A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

title: Médico(a) Veterinário(a) | Desenvolvimento de Produtos
description:
#NossoJeitoDeSer

Aqui no Grupo Carrefour Brasil vivemos o #NossoJeitoDeSer todos os dias. O Cliente está no centro da Excelência em tudo o que fazemos, e é ele quem guia nossas decisões e inspira nossas entregas. Atuamos com Coragem para simplificar e Fazer acontecer, buscando soluções simples, eficientes e sustentáveis que gerem impacto real.

E cultivamos um ambiente de Inclusão e Orgulho em Pertencer à Família, onde todas as pessoas são respeitadas, valorizadas e incentivadas a serem quem realmente são.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura e nossos valores? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a área:

A área de Desenvolvimento de Produtos de Marca Própria do Carrefour tem como missão desenvolver linhas de produtos que combinem segurança, alta qualidade sensorial, sustentabilidade e acessibilidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência aos clientes. Nossa atuação é pautada em quatro pilares: rigor na seleção e formulação, garantindo produtos seguros e de alta qualidade; acessibilidade financeira, buscando a melhor relação entre qualidade e preço; responsabilidade socioambiental, promovendo soluções mais sustentáveis ao longo da cadeia; e inovação, acompanhando tendências e desenvolvendo produtos que atendam às novas necessidades dos consumidores. Com atuação nacional, os projetos podem ter abrangência nacional ou regional, de acordo com as necessidades do negócio e dos diferentes mercados.

Desafios dessa posição:

  • Definição da linha de produtos de Marca Própria a ser desenvolvida em acordo com a área comercial levando em consideração potencial de vendas, regionalidade e cluster dos consumidores;
  • Prospecção de novos fornecedores e produtos que cumprem os requisitos para produtos das marcas Carrefour, baseando-se em pesquisas de mercado (avaliação de sortimento marca nacional e concorrência, tendências de mercado, localização da produção, calibre mínimo, impactos na biodiversidade, manejo dos produtos);
  • Reuniões de alinhamento com fornecedores sobre os conceitos das marcas Carrefour e requisitos e etapas para o desenvolvimento do projeto;
  • Elaboração de briefing para início de projeto com definição de target para o produto em desenvolvimento, levando em consideração o custo, qualidade, marca e share de mercado;
  • Análise sensorial dos produtos a serem desenvolvidos, em conjunto com a equipe de qualidade e comercial, para a validação dos targets e das características organolépticas. Caso reprovados, é realizada a proposta de adequação de formulação do produto, para que este atenda às expectativas de qualidade do projeto; solicitação das amostras;
  • Follow up de fornecedores para o preenchimento da documentação necessária (Cadernos de Encargos ou Cadernos de Especificações Técnicas), e para o agendamento de auditorias e análises laboratoriais, bem como para o cumprimento de prazos de planos de ação em eventuais reprovações em análises laboratoriais ou auditorias;
  • Acompanhamento e intermediação entre agência de arte, agência de assuntos regulatórios e fornecedores, para a elaboração da rotulagem e embalagem dos produtos;
  • Visita técnica à área produtiva (entender como a produção é realizada, documentar, analisar e retornar com os dados necessários para adequação);
  • Follow up com fornecedor para o deferimento de rótulos no sistema PGA do DIPOA (Departamento de Inspeção de Produtos de Origem Animal);
  • Cadastro dos produtos (solicitação, acompanhamento e liberação de cada SKU)
  • Análise técnica das amostras de produtos a serem lançados, como última etapa de desenvolvimento, para a confirmação de que o produto final esteja de acordo com o que foi definido ao longo do projeto. (primeira produção);
  • Visita as lojas e follow up com comercial garantindo presença no PDV
  • Compreensão e resolução de questões relacionadas ao bloqueio de produtos / fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de indicadores de desempenho de produtos marcas Carrefour (análise de vendas em volume, margem e lucro);
  • Reuniões mensais com os times comerciais para discussão de resultados da linha atual e alinhamentos diversos dos desenvolvimentos.

Você precisa ter:

Ensino Superior em Medicina Veterinária;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente;

Experiência com visitas técnicas em áreas produtivas;

Conhecimento em processos de aprovação de rótulos no sistema PGA/DIPOA.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Experiência na área de desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos MP.

title: Import Export Specialist
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Trade & Compliance Specialist processes Move Order Requests (MORs) raised from the client's and third-party warehouses across multiple locations and ensures that every shipment's commercial and trade documentation is in place and compliant with shipping practice. The role carries the deep trade-compliance expertise behind the operation — managing customs clearance, ATA Carnets, dangerous goods, brokerage performance and emerging-markets shipping research — on a 16x5 hybrid model that combines onsite presence with remote processing.

Day to day, the specialist reviews and approves commercial invoices, manages location codes within the client's commercial-invoice tooling, resolves inbound shipments stuck at customs, and produces the monthly compliance reporting and audit tracking the service requires — all in line with the logistics & compliance handbook. The role partners with Order Management, logistics and the client's compliance point of contact, escalating regulatory questions where a ruling is needed.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Move Order Request (MOR) Processing

  • Manage and process Move Order Requests (MORs) and supply-chain portal requests from initial receipt through to confirmed delivery by the carrier
  • Review Order Form entries in the relevant order systems for correct entities, Incoterms and shipment details, and update order status for non-inventory shipments via the client's ticketing system.
  • Track and update fulfillment statuses for non-inventory shipments within the enterprise ticketing and order-tracking tools.
  • Monitor backlogs to proactively flag delayed shipments, identify transit issues early, and initiate swift corrective actions.

2. Trade Documentation & Compliance

  • Review and ensure all commercial documents connected with MORs are present and compliant with shipping practice, creating manual trade documents where needed.
  • Review and approve commercial invoices generated for the various order types.
  • Process, coordinate, and manage ATA Carnets globally to facilitate temporary cross-border movements of corporate hardware and demonstration equipment.
  • Draft manual trade and customs clearance documents when automated system pipelines face data errors or exceptions.
  • Conduct proactive regulatory research into shipping laws, import/export restrictions, and tax liabilities for new or expanding global delivery locations.

3. Customs & Dangerous Goods

  • Act as the primary escalation point to coordinate, troubleshoot, and resolve international inbound shipments blocked or held at global customs borders
  • Govern and approve the shipment of hazardous or restricted commodities (specifically lithium-ion batteries) globally, providing strict packaging, safety labeling, and carrier declaration guidance
  • Maintain strict database accuracy by managing location-code data and regional entity mappings within the commercial-invoice tooling.

4. Brokerage, Reporting & Continuous Compliance

  • Compile brokerage performance metrics, track transportation costs, and maintain a country-by-country compliance audit ledger to support internal audits. Maintain brokerage performance reports and manage transportation cost and performance reporting as requested.
  • Generate and present monthly reports — tickets and bugs resolved, average resolution and acknowledgment times, logistics-documentation updates, and the country-compliance audit tracker.
  • Assist the compliance manager in developing and maintaining transportation programs across regions, and provide location-code management within the client's commercial-invoice tool.
  • Comply with the processes, procedures and instructions set out in the logistics & compliance handbook, and identify and escalate system performance issues to the local support team.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS

Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.

  • Ticket Response by Priority: respond within 1 hour for P0 (urgent/high), 3 hours for P1 (normal), and 6 hours for P2/P3/P4 (low), across all regional tickets and bugs in scope.
  • Assignment Accuracy: maintain correct HS codes, ECCN designations and Certificates of Origin on ≥99% of in-scope hardware shipments.
  • Customs Compliance: keep 100% of shipments compliant with the client's policy and customs law, evidenced through the audit tracker.
  • Reporting Cadence: deliver monthly performance and compliance reports on time, with the country-compliance audit tracker kept current.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

  • ERP Platforms: SAP (specifically Procure-to-Pay, Materials Management, and Trade Processing modules).
  • Global Logistics & Order Tools: Enterprise order-management systems, global carrier booking consoles (FedEx, DHL, freight forwarders), and warehouse portal interfaces.
  • Compliance & Invoicing Tooling: Automatic commercial-invoice generators, centralized location-code registries, and compliance database trackers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Mandatory

  • 3–7+ years of experience in international trade, customs compliance, global logistics, or cross-border supply-chain operations.
  • Expert-level command of global import/export regulations, Harmonized System (HS) classifications, ECCN codes, Incoterms (DDP vs. DAP), and Importer/Exporter of Record (IOR/EOR) liabilities.
  • Proven experience reviewing commercial invoices and creating compliant international trade paperwork across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and AMER regions.
  • Hands-on experience interpreting transport regulations for dangerous goods and hazardous cargos (specifically IATA/ADR battery compliance.
  • Commercial-invoice review and trade-documentation experience across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Clear English communication and audit-ready documentation discipline.

Preferred

  • Licensed customs-broker exposure or formal customs training.
  • Dangerous Goods (IATA / IMDG) certification.
  • Experience using SAP Trade/Logistics modules, international shipping portals, and automated commercial-invoice generators.
  • Emerging-markets trade experience and familiarity with global order-management and trade systems.

LEVELS & PROGRESSION (I – III)

One job profile spans the levels below; seniority (and compensation) is differentiated by scope, autonomy and ownership. The JD itself is common across levels.

  • Level II — processes MORs, prepares and reviews trade documents, and handles DG approvals within established procedures.
  • Level III — is the trade-compliance SME and line lead — owning customs escalations, brokerage governance, regional transportation programs, emerging-markets research and audit defense.

title: Gerente Comercial
description:

Se você quer fazer parte de um time comercial que não apenas bate metas, mas constrói crescimento sustentável todos os dias, envie seu currículo e venha transformar oportunidades em resultados com a gente!

title: Especialista de Suprimentos (Compras)
description:
As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de suprimentos para as categorias de Materiais e Serviços, alinhadas aos objetivos corporativos, planos operacionais e estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar processos estratégicos de sourcing, incluindo RFI, RFQ, RFP, BID e renegociações de alto impacto financeiro e operacional;
  • Atuar como referência técnica da área de Suprimentos, apoiando compradores e stakeholders na definição das melhores estratégias de contratação;
  • Realizar estudos de mercado, benchmarking, análise de tendências, capacidade produtiva, riscos de fornecimento e oportunidades de desenvolvimento da cadeia de suprimentos;
  • Estruturar e conduzir negociações complexas, buscando geração de valor, redução de custos, mitigação de riscos e melhoria contínua das condições comerciais;
  • Desenvolver, avaliar e implementar estratégias de gestão de categorias (Category Management), promovendo competitividade e sustentabilidade das contratações;
  • Construir e fortalecer relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, visando inovação, ganhos de produtividade e parcerias de longo prazo;
  • Liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, qualificação e expansão da base de fornecedores, assegurando competitividade, capacidade operacional e mitigação de riscos;
  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO), should cost, inteligência de mercado e demais estudos que suportem a tomada de decisão;
  • Propor e liderar projetos voltados à otimização de processos, digitalização, automação e melhoria contínua da área de Suprimentos;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas clientes na construção de escopos, modelos de contratação e estratégias de abastecimento;
  • Elaborar, monitorar e revisar planos de contingência para categorias críticas, identificando e mitigando riscos relacionados à cadeia de fornecimento;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da categoria, tais como Saving, Cost Avoidance, SLA, Cobertura Contratual, Performance de Fornecedores e Compliance, propondo ações corretivas e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas, estudos e recomendações para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança;
  • Garantir a aplicação das políticas, procedimentos, normas de compliance, governança corporativa e sustentabilidade em todos os processos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Liderar ou participar de projetos estratégicos corporativos relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, competitividade, produtividade e transformação do negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção e/ou áreas correlatas

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

•Controle de estoque e contagem física.

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Desejável conhecimento com coletores de dados;
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar de Segunda a Sábado, sendo:
  • Segunda a Sexta das 13:00h às 21:20h e Sábado das 11:00 às 19:20h.

Vale transporte; Fretado mediante disponibilidade; Refeitório no local; Sesc; Seguro de vida; Upfarma - educação corporativa; Cliente Ouro Pague menos; Plataforma de terapia online 24h; Programa gestante; Ginastica laboral; Convênio médico; Convênio odonto; Convênio farma; Educa mais; Cesta por produtividade e metas; PLR; Gympass/Wellhub, Parceria Movida, Tour house, Chip Pague Menos.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Position Overview

This role leads the import, export, and domestic logistics for biological materials to support the R&D and Regulatory teams in Brazil. Operating initially as a high-level individual contributor, the Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead will be the technical reference within the company, responsible for designing, compliance-checking, and executing the cross-border and domestic movement of research materials from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute the end-to-end import and export processes biological materials, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian and international trade regulations.
  • Act as the primary technical interface with Brazilian authorities, particularly MAPA (Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária) managing import permits (LI), and phytosanitary certificates.
  • Oversee and coordinate the secure, compliant domestic transport and logistics of biological materials between R&D sites, laboratories, and field trial sites in Brazil.
  • Partner closely with internal R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams to streamline the flow of materials needed for research, breeding, and biosafety trials.

  • Establish internal standard operating procedures (SOPs) for trade compliance, traceability, and material handling within the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Biology, Biotechnology, International Trade, or related disciplines.
  • Solid hands-on experience in import/export operations within the agricultural sector, with a strong focus on seeds.
  • Deep knowledge of MAPA regulations, phytosanitary requirements, post-entry quarantine procedures, and domestic transit rules for biological materials.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, build processes from the ground up, and act as a strategic advisor to scientific teams.
  • Fluent in English; Portuguese required.

title: Structural Analysis Engineer - Mid Level
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level Structural Analysis Engineer to support aerospace and/or aeronautical engineering projects, with a focus on metallic and/or composite structures. The engineer will be responsible for performing static analysis, fatigue analysis, and damage tolerance evaluations to support product development, certification, modifications, and in-service support activities.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in structural calculations, interpretation of technical requirements, engineering drawings, finite element modeling, and technical report preparation. A solid understanding of strength of materials, structural mechanics, margins of safety, and structural substantiation methods is required.

Key Responsibilities:

- Perform static analysis of aircraft structures using hand calculations and/or finite element methods.

- Support fatigue and structural life assessments under technical guidance.

- Support damage tolerance evaluations, including crack growth assessment and inspection criteria.

- Prepare finite element models, loads, boundary conditions, and basic correlation activities.

- Prepare clear and traceable technical reports aligned with certification requirements.

- Interface with design, loads, materials, certification, manufacturing, and product support teams.

Desired Qualifications:

- Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

- Approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in structural analysis.

- Experience with tools such as Nastran, Patran, FEMAP, HyperMesh, Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar.

- Experience with metallic and/or composite aircraft structures.

- Knowledge of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, structural margins, and certification documentation.

- Technical English for reading, report writing, and engineering communication.

title: Técnico(a) de Distribuição II
description:
Conheça o Nosso Jeito Neoenergia e seja parte!

Fazer parte da Neoenergia é atuar em uma empresa líder do setor elétrico , presente em 18 estados e no Distrito Federal, ao lado de mais de 16 mil profissionais. Com mais de R$ 50 bilhões em investimentos previstos para os próximos anos, estamos construindo o futuro da energia no Brasil.

Quer crescer com a gente?

Nossos negócios estão divididos nas áreas de geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização. As suas distribuidoras, Neoenergia Coelba (BA), Neoenergia Pernambuco (PE), Neoenergia Cosern (RN), Neoenergia Elektro (SP/MS) e Neoenergia Brasília (DF) atendem a cerca de 17 milhões de clientes.

Vivemos o Nosso Jeito Neoenergia , guiados por valores como atitude de dono , humanização , agilidade e foco na resolução , sempre buscando gerar valor para nossos clientes, colaboradores, parceiros e para a sociedade.

Confira os detalhes da vaga e venha construir um futuro melhor com a gente!

Realizar o acompanhamento das demandas da área por meio de ferramentas como Excel, Power BI, LIST, Power Automate, entre outras. Também é responsável pela identificação, análise e tratativa de processos de licenciamento relacionados a faixas de ocupação, incluindo faixas de domínio de rodovias e áreas de proteção ambiental.

Atividades:

  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

title: Ports and Shipping Specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Ports and Shipping Specialist

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006.”

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal ’ s geopolitical offer .

The contract will involve the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific .

The intended start date is January 2027 , with an implementation period of 48 months .

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Ports and Shipping Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the maritime and inland waterways sectors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of maritime, port and inland waterways infrastructure projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting port and logistics master planning, connectivity planning and multimodal transport integration.
  • Advising on port infrastructure development, maritime transport services and inland waterways systems.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Promoting sustainable maritime transport and port decarbonisation measures.
  • Supporting energy efficiency, electrification of port operations, shore-side electricity, renewable fuels and emissions reduction initiatives.
  • Advising on green port infrastructure, circular economy approaches and environmental performance.
  • Supporting climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and sustainability considerations in maritime infrastructure.
  • Contributing to policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the maritime sector.
  • Supporting capacity building for public authorities, port authorities, operators and other sector stakeholders.
  • Promoting European standards, technical practices and sustainability requirements in partner countries.
  • Supporting stakeholder coordination involving public authorities, port authorities, operators, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Master’s degree or equivalent diploma in maritime engineering, maritime sciences, port engineering, transport engineering, logistics , or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the maritime and inland waterways sectors, including ports, maritime transport, inland waterways transport and related policies and good practices.
  • Good understanding of sustainable transport, infrastructure development, climate resilience and environmental and social considerations.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the maritime sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, port authorities, operators, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of maritime infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to maritime transport and port infrastructure, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability.

Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of maritime and/or port infrastructure and services.
  • At least 3 years of proven professional experience in sustainable maritime transport and port decarbonisation, including areas such as energy efficiency, electrification of port operations, shore-side electricity, green port infrastructure, renewable fuels, emissions reduction measures, circular approaches, climate resilience and environmental performance of ports.
  • Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the maritime sector, including feasibility studies, project design, port and logistics planning, safety, environmental and social considerations, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, interoperability and master plan development.

Assets

  • Professional experience in developing countries (in situ);
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the maritime sector;
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: IP Lawyer (In-House, Brazil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive IP Lawyer to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

This is a remote-first position, offering flexibility while working closely with our international legal and business teams. However, the role requires regular attendance at court hearings, enforcement actions, and raids in São Paulo. Therefore, candidates must reside in the city of São Paulo or its metropolitan area.

You'll work directly on protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands through a combination of civil, criminal, and administrative IP enforcement.

The position focuses on hands-on IP enforcement, including drafting and sending claims, managing pre-litigation negotiations, coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities, representing clients in civil and criminal proceedings, and recovering monetary compensation from infringers.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries such as fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA, and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in Brazil.

What you will do:

  • Identify and monitor IP infringements throughout Brazil;
  • Draft and send cease-and-desist letters, legal claims, and negotiate settlements;
  • Represent rights holders in pre-litigation, civil litigation, and criminal IP proceedings;
  • Coordinate and participate in search and seizure operations (raids) and enforcement actions with local authorities (Police, Customs, Public Prosecutor's Office, regulatory agencies, etc.);
  • Draft and file powers of attorney, affidavits, criminal complaints, petitions, and litigation documents;
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies, courts, investigators, and service providers;
  • Recover monetary compensation through settlements or court decisions;
  • Support the company's legal and business operations in Brazil (contracts, compliance, office setup, banking, and corporate matters, as needed).

What we expect from you:

  • Law degree and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB);
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Intellectual Property (either in-house or at a law firm);
  • Proven experience with IP enforcement, including:
  • Civil litigation;
  • Criminal IP matters, including search and seizure actions, criminal complaints, anti-counterfeiting investigations, and interactions with police and prosecutors;
  • Experience coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities;
  • Strong legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills;
  • Fluent Portuguese and professional English (written and spoken);
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently in a global environment;
  • Must reside in São Paulo (city or metropolitan area) due to the need for in-person attendance at courts, hearings, and enforcement operations.

What We Offer:

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape BrandMonitor's legal operations in Brazil;
  • Remote-first work environment with flexibility;
  • Meaningful impact in the global fight against counterfeiting and intellectual property violations;
  • Career growth within a fast-growing international legal-tech company.

Join BrandMonitor and help protect some of the world's leading brands while making a real impact in the fight against counterfeiting.

title: HR Generalist Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a HR Generalist Specialist/Coordinator who is committed and passionate about people! This role will be responsible for the full scope of HR generalist functions -- from employee lifecycle management, to talent development, to business partnering with local leadership and supporting initiatives from our HQ in Singapore.

Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for all Garena Brazil employees, providing guidance and support across the full employee lifecycle (onboarding, performance management, development, offboarding)
  • Manage and oversee HR operations, ensuring compliance with CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws), Collective Labor Agreement, and applicable regulations
  • Lead employee engagement initiatives, including surveys, action planning, and team-level interventions
  • Oversee internal communications strategy and execution for the BR office
  • Manage Learning & Development programs, including budget administration, internal training, and vendor coordination
  • Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management
  • Conduct compensation analysis and support salary proposals for new hires and internal movements
  • Coordinate performance review cycles (mid-year and year-end conversations)
  • Manage employee relations matters independently, including investigations, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution
  • Represent the BR People team in cross-functional projects and HQ-driven initiatives
  • Contribute to People team related AI initiatives

Main job requirements:

  • 8+ years' experience in HR, with at least 3 years in a generalist or HR business partner capacity
  • Superior/higher degree completed
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian labor law (CLT) and employment regulations is a must
  • Strong background in HR Operations is a must
  • Proven experience managing the full employee lifecycle independently
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) is a must
  • Strong stakeholder management skills - able to influence and advise senior leaders
  • Strong ethics, discretion, and judgment in handling sensitive matters
  • Experience with employee engagement, L&D, and talent development
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills is a must
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Experience in the tech or gaming industry is a plus
  • Experience in using or developing AI solutions
  • Team player with a collaborative mindset
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

title: Pesquisador de Desenvolvimento Analítico Pleno
description:
Sobre a SCIENTIA

Nascemos com o DNA da inovação e hoje somos mais do que simplesmente um laboratório ou uma consultoria, a SCIENTIA é um hub de conhecimento técnico científico de alta qualidade. Nosso propósito é conectar ciência e mercado, e agora estamos abrindo as portas para quem compartilha dessa mesma paixão. Se você busca crescimento técnico em um ambiente colaborativo, venha fazer ciência com a gente!

O Desafio

Estamos em busca de um(a) Pesquisador(a) Pleno com autonomia técnica e visão analítica apurada. Você será responsável pela condução de projetos de desenvolvimento e validação, atuando na resolução de problemas complexos (troubleshooting) e garantindo a robustez técnica das entregas, além de ser uma referência para os analistas júnior.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Desenvolvimento Robusto: Desenvolver e otimizar métodos indicativos de estabilidade e análise de produtos de degradação com autonomia, utilizando HPLC e UHPLC.
  • Gestão Técnica: Planejar e executar estudos de degradação forçada (RDC 964/2025 e Guia 04/2015), interpretando dados complexos e perfis de degradação.
  • Validação Completa: Conduzir validações de metodologias analíticas (RDC 166/2017 e Guia 10/2017), garantindo o cumprimento estatístico e regulatório.
  • Documentação e Revisão: Elaborar protocolos e relatórios técnicos complexos, além de auxiliar na revisão de dados brutos gerados pela equipe.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Atuar ativamente no troubleshooting de equipamentos e métodos, propondo soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Interface Técnica: Participar de discussões científicas avançadas com a equipe e, eventualmente, apoiar no suporte técnico a clientes.

Para se candidatar, você precisa

  • Formação: Superior completo em Química ou Farmácia. Pós-graduação ou especialização na área analítica será um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Experiência sólida e comprovada em laboratório de desenvolvimento analítico (indispensável domínio das rotinas de P&D).
  • Domínio Técnico: Expertise em cromatografia líquida (HPLC/UHPLC) e gasosa (GC), desenvolvimento de métodos do zero e tratamento estatístico de dados.
  • Regulatório: Profundo conhecimento das normas da ANVISA (RDC 964, RDC 166, RDC 318, etc.).
  • Idiomas e Ferramentas: Inglês técnico (leitura avançada/escrita intermediária) e domínio do Pacote Office.
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais na região da Grande São Paulo.

Por que escolher a SCIENTIA?

Oferecemos um ambiente onde sua experiência é valorizada. Aqui você terá espaço para propor inovações, liderar frentes técnicas e continuar seu desenvolvimento através de um plano de carreira estruturado , com desafios à altura da sua experiência.

title: Analista Fiscal Sênior (Impostos Diretos e Indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company’s tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary.
  • Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others.
  • Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information.
  • Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements.
  • Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications.
  • Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team.
  • Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information.
  • Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.
  • Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients.
  • Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.
  • Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company.
  • Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes.
  • Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF.
  • Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices.
  • Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company’s operations.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

• Position offered shall be determined by the candidate’s years of relevant experience and skillsets.

• All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

title: Vendedora (E-commerce)
description:
VAGA: Vendedora – Dalla Store

Presencial — São Caetano do Sul

Remuneração: Fixo + comissão sobre vendas

Horário sugerido: Segunda a Sexta, das 9:00 às 18:00 horas

Vaga Efetiva (com experiência de 3 meses)

SOBRE A DALLA STORE

A Dalla não contrata pra preencher cadeira.

Somos um e-commerce de moda feminina em crescimento acelerado, com o propósito de facilitar a rotina das mulheres através de conjuntos práticos, confortáveis e estilosos. Estamos construindo a maior marca brasileira de conjuntos femininos até 2035 — e o time precisa crescer nesse ritmo.

Essa vaga não é de "responder mensagem no automático e esperar a venda acontecer". É de assumir o relacionamento com a cliente do primeiro contato até a compra — e fazer ela voltar.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Você vai garantir que cada conversa com a cliente seja conduzida com clareza, agilidade e poder de conversão — do primeiro "oi" até o fechamento.

O jogo é claro: se a cliente compra, recomenda e volta a comprar... você venceu. E vai ser recompensada por isso.

  • Atender e conduzir vendas via Instagram e WhatsApp, do primeiro contato ao fechamento
  • Identificar a necessidade da cliente e indicar o produto certo — sem empurrar peça errada só pra bater meta
  • Fazer follow-up ativo de carrinhos abandonados e clientes em negociação, sem deixar lead esfriar
  • Identificar objeções recorrentes e ajustar a abordagem antes que virem perda de venda
  • Bater metas diárias e semanais de conversão e ticket médio
  • Garantir que a cliente saia satisfeita e pronta para comprar de novo

O Que Esperamos de Você

  • Comunicação escrita ágil, persuasiva e sem erro de português — você escreve rápido e bem o dia inteiro
  • Resiliência de verdade — muita conversa não vira venda, e isso não pode te abalar nem mudar seu padrão de atendimento
  • Organização para conduzir várias conversas em paralelo sem perder o timing de cada uma
  • Leitura de cenário e senso de dono — perceber quando uma cliente está quase fechando e agir, sem esperar comando
  • Capacidade de receber feedback e cobrança como parte do jogo — aqui ninguém vai adivinhar o que você sente, vamos te dizer na cara o que precisa melhorar

Diferenciais (Vai Te Destacar Muito)

  • Já vendeu algo — online, loja física ou redes sociais — e tem exemplo concreto de resultado, não só "tenho jeito com pessoas"
  • Experiência em atendimento de alto volume via Instagram/WhatsApp
  • Vivência com moda, e-commerce ou vendas consultivas
  • Familiaridade com métricas básicas de venda (conversão, ticket médio, follow-up)

Não É Pra Você Se:

  • Precisa que expliquem o que dizer em cada nova objeção da cliente
  • Acha que vendas é só "responder o que perguntam" e esperar a cliente decidir sozinha
  • Não lida bem com "não" — e desanima ou perde ritmo depois de uma sequência de recusas
  • Busca ambiente estável, sem meta e sem pressão por resultado
  • Não se sente confortável sendo cobrada por número, todos os dias

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Comissão real sobre performance, sem teto
  • Treinamento sobre produto, abordagem e cultura Dalla
  • Ambiente de ritmo acelerado, com metas claras e feedback constante
  • Possibilidade real de evolução para liderança de vendas conforme a Dalla escala
  • A chance de sentir na pele o impacto direto do seu trabalho no resultado da empresa
